description: This file defines a custom XAML trigger class 'AspectRatioTrigger' used within a Windows UI application to activate visual states based on the aspect ratio (height/width) of a FrameworkElement. It includes properties for source element, numerator aspect (height or width), threshold, and whether equality counts for activation. The class manages size change events to update trigger state dynamically.

classes.name: Aspect
classes.description: Enumeration for specifying whether height or width is used as the numerator in aspect ratio calculations.

classes.name: AspectRatioTrigger
classes.description: A custom trigger class for activating visual states based on the aspect ratio of a FrameworkElement.

methods.name: AspectRatioTrigger
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the trigger and sets it to inactive.

methods.name: OnSourcePropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the Source property, unregistering old size change events and registering new ones.

methods.name: RegisterSizeChanged
methods.description: Registers the SizeChanged event handler for a given FrameworkElement.

methods.name: UnregisterSizeChanged
methods.description: Unregisters the SizeChanged event handler for a given FrameworkElement.

methods.name: OnSizeChanged
methods.description: Event handler invoked when the size of the source element changes; updates the trigger state.

methods.name: UpdateIsActive
methods.description: Calculates the aspect ratio and updates the trigger's active state based on the threshold and configuration.
